input_digest_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(inputs, sort_keys=True, separators=(comma, colon))
carrier: Evidence-only successor commit; exact SHA is supplied in the PR/handoff and verified by Git.
exact_carrier_gate: A further complete archive gate and API verification are recorded in the PR/handoff after committing the carrier; they must pass before handoff. Committed receipts are not relabelled.
closure: Source qualification candidate; Independent Review/JUDGE and released-build readback/cleanup pending.
pending_igor: Same-vendor LSA→TPM and keep_native binding remain refused; no acceptance claimed.
limits: Pre-existing message-proof timestamp TEXT-order defect; accepted unrelated signature only, unrepaired
PR close is non-atomic and retry converges; generic refusal wording remains a candidate
No-proved-container close branch source-verified, not directly tested
publication_exception: Paseo-direct draft publication uses --without-attestation to avoid a live Kontor publication ledger/epic write under CON-007; no outage is claimed.
